incidentLocation: Highway 101 Northbound, Mile Marker 47, San Jose, CA
incidentDescription: I was traveling northbound in the right lane when the vehicle in front of me suddenly braked hard. I applied my brakes but was unable to stop in time, resulting in a rear-end collision. My passenger complained of neck pain immediately after impact. The other driver claims I was following too closely.

policyContext.coverageType: Comprehensive Auto Insurance with Medical Coverage
relevantClauses: Section 4.2: Collision coverage applies with $1000 deductible
Section 5.1: Medical payments coverage up to $10,000 per person
Section 6.1: Rental reimbursement up to $50/day for 30 days
Section 8.2: Liability coverage up to $100,000 per person for bodily injury
ambiguityIndicators: Liability dispute - other driver claims claimant was following too closely
Medical claim requires verification of injury causation

blockerReason: Medical evaluation pending and liability dispute requires senior adjuster review before settlement authorization
lastAgentAction: Medical DW reviewed emergency room records and requested follow-up examination

narrativeSynthesis.description: Rear-end collision occurred on Highway 101 during evening commute
Passenger Emily Wu reported neck and shoulder pain at scene
Passenger transported to San Jose Medical Center by ambulance
Other driver claims claimant was following too closely and distracted
Witness states traffic was heavy and sudden braking was unavoidable
Claimant submitted FNOL via mobile app with photos and police report
Medical DW reviewed emergency room records - passenger diagnosed with whiplash and soft tissue injuries
Repair estimate received showing $8,400 in vehicle damage
Follow-up medical examination scheduled for passenger

anomalySignals.description: Conflicting statements between claimant and other driver regarding following distance and attention to road
Passenger injury claim with ongoing medical treatment - potential exposure exceeds $15,000
Combined vehicle and medical damages approach senior adjuster approval threshold of $25,000

evidenceItems.description: Official accident report with diagram, witness statements, and officer observations
8 photos showing front-end damage to claimant vehicle and rear damage to other vehicle
Emergency room records from San Jose Medical Center
Written statement from Maria Rodriguez describing traffic conditions
Detailed repair estimate from certified auto body shop
Active auto insurance policy with medical and collision coverage

recommendedAction.description: Escalate to senior adjuster for liability determination and settlement authority due to disputed liability and high medical exposure
recommendedAction.rationale: Liability is disputed with conflicting statements. Medical exposure is significant and ongoing. Combined damages approach authority threshold. Witness statement supports claimant but does not definitively establish fault. Senior review required before settlement authorization.
recommendedAction.estimatedImpact: Settlement decision delayed 3-5 business days pending senior review. Potential total exposure $20,000-$28,000 including medical, vehicle repair, and rental costs.
recommendedAction.claimantMessage: We are reviewing your claim and have requested additional medical documentation. A senior adjuster will contact you within 48 hours to discuss the liability aspects of your claim. Your rental car has been authorized for up to 14 days.

breakdown.description: Emergency room visit, follow-up care, and physical therapy (estimated)

auditTrail.outcome: FNOL intake completed via mobile app
Emergency room records reviewed, whiplash and soft tissue injuries confirmed
Coverage confirmed for collision and medical payments
Repair estimate reviewed and validated at $8,400
Case flagged for senior adjuster review due to liability dispute and high medical exposure
